$$ \text{Cost per candy} = \frac{\text{Total cost of candies}}{\text{Number of candies}} $$
$$ \text{Cost per candy} = \frac{3.20}{4} = 0.80 $$
So, each candy costs $0.80.

**Step 2: Determine the cost of the lollipops.**

$$ \text{Cost per lollipop} = 0.40 $$

**Step 3: Calculate the cost of 10 lollipops.**
$$ \text{Cost of 10 lollipops} = 10 \times 0.40 = 4.00 $$

**Step 4: Calculate the cost of 10 candies.**
$$ \text{Cost of 10 candies} = 10 \times 0.80 = 8.00 $$

**Step 5: Calculate the total cost.**
$$ \text{Total Cost} = \text{Cost of 10 lollipops} + \text{Cost of 10 candies} $$
$$ \text{Total Cost} = 4.00 + 8.00 = 12.00 $$

The total amount Manolo will spend is $12.00.
